title: ChatHealthy FDA Product To Diagnosis Resolution
description: ChatHealthy's FDA drug collection at the MOLECULE grain (EPIC-010-F-007, LLD v83 III.4.1): one document per molecule, _id == molecule_id, assembling the molecule's SPL labels. Each label folds in exactly once; set_ids carries the contributing labels' set_ids, and a label whose set_id is already present is disregarded as already processed. OTC-only labels are excluded from the built output (retained in staging). The molecule master and the enrich path join to this record by molecule_id -- a point lookup on _id.

_id.description: == molecule_id; the collection is keyed on the molecule.

molecule_id.description: Proprietary molecule surrogate (LLD v83 III.3 decision #2). Never shown to a user.

set_ids.description: The FDA SPL set_ids of the labels folded into this record -- the contributing record keys. A label folds in at most once. This array exists ONLY in this collection (operator ruling 2026-10-20).

clean_names.description: Clean molecule name(s) unioned across the molecule's labels.

rxcui.description: openfda.rxcui unioned across labels, when present.

unii.description: openfda.unii unioned across labels, when present.

substance_name.description: openfda.substance_name unioned across labels, when present.

_molecule_sources.description: Provenance of the clean molecule name(s), unioned across the folded labels.

indications.description: On-label indications unioned across the molecule's labels, deduplicated by normalized indication text, ICD-10 codes unioned by code and split to level3/level4.

raw_text.description: FDA indication wording (indications_and_usage, or package_label_principal_display_panel fallback).

level4.description: 4-char ICD-10-CM codes (may be empty). Level 5 not carried.

trust.description: Model confidence for an INFERRED crosswalk (PROPOSED, EPIC-010-F-002): the weakest code confidence in the union; null when none is carried.

summarized_usage.description: Summarized usage, unioned across the folded labels.

classes.description: SET across the molecule's labels: a molecule can carry both OTC and Rx labels. UNDETERMINED never defaulted.

brand_exact_keys.description: Normalized exact brand keys (tier 1) unioned across labels; the CMS brand matches on these. Indexed (LLD v83 III.8).

brand_keys.description: Salt/form-normalized brand keys (tier 2) unioned across labels. Indexed.

generic_keys.description: Normalized generic keys (tier 3) unioned across labels. Indexed.

trust.description: Aggregate of the folded labels' resolution confidence (model confidence where resolution was inferred).

min.description: Smallest value greater than zero -- a 0 is not a min; zero values are excluded. Null when no non-zero value exists.

avg.description: The sum divided by the count.
